local function v_u_8(p2, p3) -- name: patrolProgressSeconds
	local v4 = p3 / 2
	local v5 = math.min(2, v4)
	if p2 <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	if p3 <= p2 then
		return p3 - v5
	end
	local v6 = v5 / 2
	if p2 < v5 then
		return p2 * p2 / (v5 * 2)
	end
	if p2 <= p3 - v5 then
		return v6 + (p2 - v5)
	end
	local v7 = p2 - (p3 - v5)
	return v6 + (p3 - v5 * 2) + (v7 - v7 * v7 / (v5 * 2))
end

local function v_u_167(p119, p120) -- name: approachCFrame
	local v121 = p119.Departure
	local v122 = p119.Target
	local v123 = p119.ReturnTarget
	if p119.Aborted then
		if p120 < p119.AbortElapsed then
			local v124 = p120 / p119.OutDuration
			local v125 = v121:Lerp(v122, (math.clamp(v124, 0, 1)))
			local v126 = v122 - v121
			local v127
			if v126.Magnitude > 0.001 then
				local v128 = CFrame.lookAt
				local v129 = v126.X
				local v130 = v126.Z
				v127 = v128(v125, v125 + Vector3.new(v129, 0, v130))
			else
				v127 = CFrame.new(v125)
			end
			return v127, true, false
		end
		local v131 = p120 - p119.AbortElapsed
		if v131 >= p119.BackDuration then
			local v132
			if (Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)).Magnitude > 0.001 then
				v132 = CFrame.lookAt(v123, v123 + Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
			else
				v132 = CFrame.new(v123)
			end
			return v132, false, true
		end
		local v133 = p119.AbortPosition
		local v134 = v131 / p119.BackDuration
		local v135 = v133:Lerp(v123, (math.clamp(v134, 0, 1)))
		local v136 = v123 - p119.AbortPosition
		local v137
		if v136.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			local v138 = CFrame.lookAt
			local v139 = v136.X
			local v140 = v136.Z
			v137 = v138(v135, v135 + Vector3.new(v139, 0, v140))
		else
			v137 = CFrame.new(v135)
		end
		return v137, true, false
	elseif p120 < p119.OutDuration then
		local v141 = p120 / p119.OutDuration
		local v142 = v121:Lerp(v122, (math.clamp(v141, 0, 1)))
		local v143 = v122 - v121
		local v144
		if v143.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			local v145 = CFrame.lookAt
			local v146 = v143.X
			local v147 = v143.Z
			v144 = v145(v142, v142 + Vector3.new(v146, 0, v147))
		else
			v144 = CFrame.new(v142)
		end
		return v144, true, false
	elseif p120 < p119.OutDuration + p119.ActDuration then
		local v148 = p119.FaceTarget
		if v148 then
			local v149 = v148 - v122
			local v150
			if v149.Magnitude > 0.001 then
				local v151 = CFrame.lookAt
				local v152 = v149.X
				local v153 = v149.Z
				v150 = v151(v122, v122 + Vector3.new(v152, 0, v153))

			end

			local v155

				local v156 = CFrame.lookAt
				local v157 = v154.X
				local v158 = v154.Z
				v155 = v156(v122, v122 + Vector3.new(v157, 0, v158))
			else
				v155 = CFrame.new(v122)
			end
			return v155, false, false
		end
	else
		if p120 >= p119.Total then
			local v159
			if (Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)).Magnitude > 0.001 then

			else
				v159 = CFrame.new(v123)
			end
			return v159, false, true
		end
		local v160 = (p120 - p119.OutDuration - p119.ActDuration) / p119.BackDuration
		local v161 = v122:Lerp(v123, (math.clamp(v160, 0, 1)))
		local v162 = v123 - v122
		local v163

			local v166 = v162.Z
			v163 = v164(v161, v161 + Vector3.new(v165, 0, v166))
		else
			v163 = CFrame.new(v161)
		end
		return v163, true, false
	end
end

local v_u_1 = {}
local v8 = {
	["Parabola"] = {
		["lift"] = function(p2) -- name: lift
			return p2 * 4 * (1 - p2)
		end,
		["slope"] = function(p3) -- name: slope
			return (1 - p3 * 2) * 4
		end
	},
	["Sine"] = {
		["lift"] = function(p4) -- name: lift
			local v5 = 3.141592653589793 * p4
			return math.sin(v5)
		end,
		["slope"] = function(p6) -- name: slope
			local v7 = 3.141592653589793 * p6
			return 3.141592653589793 * math.cos(v7)
		end
	}
}
v_u_1.Profiles = v8
local function v_u_13(p9, p10) -- name: rotationBetween
	local v11 = p9:Dot(p10)
	if v11 > 0.9999 then
		return CFrame.identity
	end
	if v11 >= -0.9999 then
		return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(p9:Cross(p10).Unit, (math.acos(v11)))
	end
	local v12 = p9:Cross(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
	if v12.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
		v12 = p9:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v12.Unit, 3.141592653589793)
end
local function v_u_22(p14, p15, p16, p17) -- name: orientToDirection
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13
	local v18 = p15.Unit
	local v19 = p17 or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	if v19:Cross(v18).Magnitude < 0.0001 then
		local v20 = v18.Z
		v19 = math.abs(v20) > 0.9999 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	end
	local v21 = CFrame.lookAt(p14, p14 + v18, v19)
	if p16 then
		return v21 * v_u_13(p16.Unit, Vector3.new(-0, -0, -1))
	else
		return v21
	end
end
local function v_u_47(p_u_23, p_u_24) -- name: makeCurve
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_22
	return {

function v_u_1.Quadratic(p_u_60, p_u_61, p_u_62) -- name: Quadratic

	end, function(p72)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_67, (copy) p_u_66, (copy) p_u_68, (copy) p_u_69
		local v73 = 1 - p72
		return (p_u_67 - p_u_66) * (3 * v73 * v73) + (p_u_68 - p_u_67) * (6 * v73 * p72) + (p_u_69 - p_u_68) * (3 * p72 * p72)
	end)

function v_u_1.Missile(p74, p75, p76) -- name: Missile

	local v77 = p76.launchDirection.Unit

	local v80 = p74 + v77 * p76.forwardPush + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * (p76.height * 0.5)
	local v81 = p75 - v78 * v79

function v_u_1.Length(p86, p87) -- name: Length
	local v88 = p87 or 16

	local v90 = 0
	for v91 = 1, v88 do
		local v92 = p86:PositionAt(v91 / v88)
		v90 = v90 + (v92 - v89).Magnitude
		v89 = v92
	end

end
function v_u_1.FlightTime(p93, p94) -- name: FlightTime

local function v16(p11) -- name: deriveEquippedTemplate
	local v12 = p11:Clone()
	local v13 = v12:FindFirstChild("Mount") or v12:FindFirstChild("Boat")
	if v13 then
		v13:Destroy()
	end
	local v14 = v12:FindFirstChild("Commander") or v12
	local v15 = v14:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (v15 and v15:IsA("BasePart")) then
		if v14 and (v14:IsA("Model") and v14.PrimaryPart) then
			v12.PrimaryPart = v14.PrimaryPart
		end
		return v12
	end
	v12.PrimaryPart = v15
	v15.Anchored = true
	return v12
end

	if p24 <= p23 then
		return p24 - v26
	end
	local v27 = v26 / 2
	if p23 < v26 then
		return p23 * p23 / (v26 * 2)
	end
	if p23 <= p24 - v26 then
		return v27 + (p23 - v26)
	end
	local v28 = p23 - (p24 - v26)
	return v27 + (p24 - v26 * 2) + (v28 - v28 * v28 / (v26 * 2))
end
function v_u_22.PlanRoute(p30, p31) -- name: PlanRoute
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_22
	local v32 = p31.Speed
	local v33 = tonumber(v32) or 1
	local v34 = math.max(v33, 0.05)
	local v35 = p30.OrbitRadius
	local v36 = p31.FromAngle
	local v37 = p31.ToAngle
	local v38 = p31.FromRadius or v35
	local v39 = p31.ToRadius or v35
	local v40 = v_u_22.AngleDelta(v36, v37)
	local v41 = {}
	local v42 = 0
	local v43 = {
		["Kind"] = "Radial",
		["Angle"] = nil,
		["FromRadius"] = nil,
		["ToRadius"] = nil,
		["Angle"] = v36,
		["FromRadius"] = v38,
		["ToRadius"] = v35
	}
	local v44 = v35 - v38
	local v45 = math.abs(v44)
	if v45 > 0 then
		v43.StartDistance = v42
		v43.Length = v45
		v42 = v42 + v45
		table.insert(v41, v43)
	end
	local v46 = {
		["Kind"] = "Arc",
		["FromAngle"] = nil,
		["Delta"] = nil,
		["Radius"] = nil,
		["FromAngle"] = v36,
		["Delta"] = v40,
		["Radius"] = v35
	}
	local v47 = math.abs(v40) * v35
	if v47 > 0 then
		v46.StartDistance = v42
		v46.Length = v47
		v42 = v42 + v47
		table.insert(v41, v46)
	end
	local v48 = {
		["Kind"] = "Radial",
		["Angle"] = nil,
		["FromRadius"] = nil,
		["ToRadius"] = nil,
		["Angle"] = v37,
		["FromRadius"] = v35,
		["ToRadius"] = v39
	}
	local v49 = v39 - v35
	local v50 = math.abs(v49)
	if v50 > 0 then
		v48.StartDistance = v42
		v48.Length = v50
		v42 = v42 + v50
		table.insert(v41, v48)
	end
	local v51 = v42 / v34
	local v52
	if v51 >= 2 then
		v52 = v51 + 2
	else
		v52 = v51 * 2
	end
	return {
		["OrbitData"] = p30,
		["StartTime"] = p31.StartTime,
		["Segments"] = v41,
		["Length"] = v42,
		["Speed"] = v34,
		["Duration"] = v52,
		["EndAngle"] = v37,
		["EndRadius"] = v39,
		["EndLookAt"] = p31.EndLookAt
	}
end
function v_u_22.GetRouteCFrame(p53, p54) -- name: GetRouteCFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_22
	local v55 = p53.OrbitData
	local v56 = p54 - p53.StartTime
	local v57 = p53.Duration <= v56
	local v58 = v_u_29
	local v59 = p53.Duration
	local v60 = v58(math.clamp(v56, 0, v59), p53.Duration)
	local v61 = p53.Speed * v60
	local v62 = p53.Length
	local v63 = math.clamp(v61, 0, v62)
	if not v57 then
		for _, v64 in p53.Segments do
			local v65 = v63 - v64.StartDistance
			if v65 >= 0 and v64.Length >= v65 then
				local v66 = v65 / v64.Length
				if v64.Kind == "Radial" then
					local v67 = v64.FromRadius + (v64.ToRadius - v64.FromRadius) * v66
					local v68 = v_u_22.PositionAt(v55, v64.Angle, v67)
					local v69 = v67 + (v64.ToRadius >= v64.FromRadius and 1 or -1)
					local v70 = v_u_22.PositionAt(v55, v64.Angle, v69)
					return CFrame.lookAt(v68, v70), false
				else
					local v71 = v64.FromAngle + v64.Delta * v66
					local v72 = v_u_22.PositionAt(v55, v71, v64.Radius)
					local v73 = v71 + (v64.Delta >= 0 and 0.05 or -0.05)
					local v74 = v_u_22.PositionAt(v55, v73, v64.Radius)
					return CFrame.lookAt(v72, v74), false
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local v75 = v_u_22.PositionAt(v55, p53.EndAngle, p53.EndRadius)
	local v76 = p53.EndLookAt
	local v77
	if typeof(v76) == "Vector3" then
		local v78 = v76.X
		local v79 = v75.Y
		local v80 = v76.Z
		v77 = Vector3.new(v78, v79, v80)
	else
		local v81 = v55.OrbitCenter.Position
		local v82 = v81.X
		local v83 = v75.Y
		local v84 = v81.Z
		v77 = Vector3.new(v82, v83, v84)
	end
	if (v77 - v75).Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return CFrame.new(v75), v57
	else
		return CFrame.lookAt(v75, v77), v57
	end
end
return v_u_22

		end
		for _, v20 in v_u_2:GetChildren() do
			local v21 = v20:Clone()
			v21:SetAttribute("MagmaEffectInstance", true)
			v21.Parent = v15
		end
	end
	local v22 = v_u_13(p14, v15)
	v22.Magma.Visible = true
	v22.Locked.Visible = p14:GetAttribute("Locked") == true
	return true
end
return v4

local function v_u_242(p_u_233, p234) -- name: freezeCommanderDuringTrack
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	if p_u_233 and p234 then

		p_u_233.MovementPaused = true

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_237, (copy) p_u_233, (ref) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_235
			if not v_u_237 then
				v_u_237 = true

	end
end

				else

					if not v275 then
						v275 = {}
						v_u_44[p251] = v275
					end
					v275[p252] = p_u_253
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
local function v_u_294(p276) -- name: updateLandCommander
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_39
	if p276.MovementPaused then
		return
	else
		local v277 = p276.PathData
		local v278 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		if not p276.LastTick then
			p276.LastTick = v278
		end
		local v279 = v278 - p276.LastTick
		p276.LastTick = v278
		local v280 = p276.Interrupt
		if v280 then
			if not (v280.Aborted or v280._ApproachArriveFired) then
				local v281 = v_u_17.GetApproachArrival(v277, v280)
				local v282 = v278 - v280.ApproachStartTime
				if v281 <= v282 and v282 <= v281 + v280.ActDuration then
					v280._ApproachArriveFired = true
					v_u_39:HandleCommanderApproachArrive(p276.Player, p276.CommanderType, v280.ClientContext or {})
				end
			end
			if v_u_17.GetApproachTotal(v277, v280) <= v278 - v280.ApproachStartTime then
				v277.ClockOffset = v_u_17.GetApproachClockOffset(v277, v280)
				p276.Interrupt = nil
				v280 = nil
			end
		end
		local v283, v284 = v_u_17.GetCFrame(v277, v278, v280)
		local v285 = p276.VisualCFrame
		if v285 then
			local v286 = v279 * -3
			local v287 = 1 - math.exp(v286)
			local v288 = math.min(v287, 0.05)
			local v289 = v285.Rotation:Lerp(v283.Rotation, v288)
			v283 = CFrame.new(v283.Position) * v289
		end
		p276.VisualCFrame = v283
		p276.Instance:PivotTo(p276.VisualCFrame)
		local v290 = p276.MovementSound
		if v290 then
			if v284 and not v290.IsPlaying then
				v290:Play()
			elseif not v284 and v290.IsPlaying then
				v290:Pause()
			end
		end
		local v291 = p276.WalkTrack
		if v291 then
			if v284 and p276.AnimState ~= "Walk" then
				p276.AnimState = "Walk"
				local v292 = p276.Idle
				if v292 then
					v292.Track:Stop(0.2)
					if v292.Sound then
						v292.Sound:Stop()
					end
				end
				if not p276.KeepWalkPlaying then
					v291:Play(0.2)
					v291:AdjustSpeed(1.85)
					return
				end
			elseif not v284 and p276.AnimState ~= "Idle" then
				p276.AnimState = "Idle"
				if not p276.KeepWalkPlaying then
					v291:Stop(0.2)
				end
				local v293 = p276.Idle
				if not v293 then
					return
				end
				v293.Track:Play(0.2)
				if v293.Sound then
					v293.Sound:Play()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

		end

	v_u_3.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p369)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_40, (copy) p_u_368, (ref) v_u_44
		local v370 = v_u_40[p369]
		if v370 then
			for v371 in v370 do
				p_u_368:DestroyCommander(p369, v371)
			end
			v_u_40[p369] = nil
			v_u_44[p369] = nil
		end
	end)
	v_u_2.RenderStepped:Connect(function(p372)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_42, (ref) v_u_294, (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_14
		for _, v373 in v_u_42 do
			if v373.DisabledUntil and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < v373.DisabledUntil then
				local v374 = v373.MovementSound
				if v374 and v374.IsPlaying then
					v374:Pause()
				end
			elseif v373.MovementType == "Land" then
				v_u_294(v373)
			elseif v373.MovementType ~= "Stationary" then
				if v373.MovementType == "Air" then
					v_u_19.Update(v373)
				elseif not v373.RaidActive then
					if v373.NavalOverride then
						local v375 = v373.NavalRoute
						local v376 = v373.MovementSound
						if v375 then
							local v377, v378 = v_u_15.GetRouteCFrame(v375, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
							local v379 = v377.LookVector
							local v380 = -v379.X
							local v381 = -v379.Z
							local v382 = math.atan2(v380, v381)
							local v383 = v373.NavalYaw
							if v383 == nil then
								local v384 = v373.Instance:GetPivot().LookVector
								local v385 = -v384.X
								local v386 = -v384.Z
								v383 = math.atan2(v385, v386)
							end
							local v387 = -2.5 * p372
							local v388 = 1 - math.exp(v387)
							local v389 = v383 + v_u_15.AngleDelta(v383, v382) * v388
							v373.NavalYaw = v389
							v373.Instance:PivotTo(CFrame.new(v377.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, v389, 0))
							if v376 then
								if v378 and v376.IsPlaying then
									v376:Pause()
								elseif not (v378 or v376.IsPlaying) then
									v376:Play()
								end
							end
							if v378 and not v375.ArrivedFired then
								v375.ArrivedFired = true
								local v390 = v373.NavalRouteArrived
								v373.NavalRouteArrived = nil
								if v390 then
									task.spawn(v390, v373)
								end
							end
						elseif v376 and v376.IsPlaying then
							v376:Pause()
						end
					else
						local v391, v392 = v_u_14.GetAngle(v373.PathData, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
						local v393 = v373.VisualAngleOffset
						local v394 = -1.15 * p372
						v373.VisualAngleOffset = v393 * math.exp(v394)
						v373.Instance:PivotTo(v_u_14.GetCFrameFromAngle(v373.PathData, v391 + v373.VisualAngleOffset))
						local v395 = v373.MovementSound
						if v392 or v395.IsPlaying then
							if v392 and v395.IsPlaying then
								v395:Pause()
							end
						else

local function v_u_93() -- name: basesCenterAndSpan
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	local v74 = v_u_7:FindFirstChild("Bases")
	if not v74 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 200
	end
	local v75 = (1 / 0)
	local v76 = (-1 / 0)
	local v77 = (1 / 0)
	local v78 = (-1 / 0)
	local v79 = 0
	local v80 = 0
	for _, v81 in ipairs(v74:GetChildren()) do
		local v82 = v81:FindFirstChild("Floor")
		if v82 and v82:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v83 = v82.Position.X - v82.Size.X / 2
			v75 = math.min(v75, v83)
			local v84 = v82.Position.X + v82.Size.X / 2
			v76 = math.max(v76, v84)
			local v85 = v82.Position.Z - v82.Size.Z / 2
			v77 = math.min(v77, v85)
			local v86 = v82.Position.Z + v82.Size.Z / 2
			v78 = math.max(v78, v86)
			v79 = v79 + v82.Position.Y
			v80 = v80 + 1
		end
	end
	if v80 == 0 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), 200
	end
	local v87 = (v75 + v76) / 2
	local v88 = v79 / v80
	local v89 = (v77 + v78) / 2
	local v90 = Vector3.new(v87, v88, v89)
	local v91 = v76 - v75
	local v92 = v78 - v77
	return v90, math.max(v91, v92)
end

function v_u_7.Update(p70) -- name: Update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_28
	if p70.Patrolling then
		if p70.Departing then
			return
		else
			local v71 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if not p70.AirLastTick then
				p70.AirLastTick = v71
			end
			local v72 = v71 - p70.AirLastTick
			p70.AirLastTick = v71
			if v72 <= 0 then
				return
			else
				local v73 = math.min(v72, 0.1)
				if p70.AirMode == "Refuel" and (p70.RestingCFrame and p70.Landed) then
					p70.Instance:PivotTo(p70.RestingCFrame)
					if p70.DeferredAirMode and (not p70.RefuelHoldUntil or p70.RefuelHoldUntil <= v71) then
						local v74 = p70.DeferredAirMode
						v_u_7.SetMode(p70, v74.Mode, v74.TargetPosition, v74.FaceTarget)
					end
					return
				else
					local v75 = p70.AirPosition or p70.Instance:GetPivot().Position
					local v76 = p70.AirVelocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					local v77 = nil
					local v78 = false
					local v79 = false
					local v80
					if p70.Ascending and p70.AscentTarget then
						v80 = p70.AscentTarget
						if (v75 - p70.AscentTarget).Magnitude <= 8 then
							p70.Ascending = false
						end
					elseif p70.AirMode == "Engage" and p70.AirTarget then
						local v81 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Center")
						local v82
						if v81 then
							v82 = v81:GetPivot().Position
						else
							v82 = nil
						end
						v77 = v82 or p70.AirTarget
						if not p70.EngageHoverTarget then
							p70.EngageHoverTarget = p70.AirTarget + v_u_17()
						end
						if (v75 - p70.EngageHoverTarget).Magnitude <= 6 then
							p70.EngageHoldUntil = p70.EngageHoldUntil or v71 + 2.5
							if p70.EngageHoldUntil <= v71 then
								p70.EngageHoverTarget = p70.AirTarget + v_u_17()
								p70.EngageHoldUntil = nil
							end
						else
							p70.EngageHoldUntil = nil
						end
						v80 = p70.EngageHoverTarget
						v78 = true
					elseif p70.AirMode == "Dive" and p70.AirTarget then
						v77 = p70.AirFaceTarget or p70.AirTarget
						v80 = p70.AirTarget
						v78 = true
					elseif p70.AirMode == "Refuel" and p70.RestingCFrame then
						v80 = p70.RestingCFrame.Position
						v77 = p70.RestingCFrame * Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
						v79 = true
						v78 = true
					else
						v80 = v_u_5.GetCFrame(p70.PathData, v71).Position
					end
					local v83 = v80 - v75
					local v84 = v83.Magnitude
					local v85 = v_u_5.FlightSpeed
					if v78 then
						local v86 = v_u_5.FlightSpeed
						local v87 = v84 * 1.5
						v85 = math.min(v86, v87)
					end
					local v88 = v84 <= 0.001 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v83.Unit * v85
					local v89 = -3 * v73
					local v90 = v76:Lerp(v88, 1 - math.exp(v89))
					if v90.Magnitude > v_u_5.FlightSpeed then
						v90 = v90.Unit * v_u_5.FlightSpeed
					end
					local v91 = v75 + v90 * v73
					if v79 and (v91 - v80).Magnitude <= 2 then
						p70.Landed = true
						p70.AirPosition = p70.RestingCFrame.Position
						p70.AirVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
						p70.AirYaw = select(2, p70.RestingCFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())
						p70.AirBank = 0
						p70.AirPitch = 0
						p70.Instance:PivotTo(p70.RestingCFrame)
						if p70.IdleTrack then
							p70.IdleTrack:Stop()
						end
						if p70.PatrolSound then
							p70.PatrolSound:Stop()
						end
						if p70.PendingInspect then
							local v92 = p70.PendingInspect.Duration
							p70.RefuelHoldUntil = v71 + v92

local function v_u_35(p31, p32) -- name: evaluateCurve
	local v33 = math.clamp(p32, 0, 1)
	local v34 = string.lower(string.gsub(p31, "%s+", ""))
	if v34 == "inquad" or v34 == "quadin" then
		return v33 * v33
	elseif v34 == "outquad" or v34 == "quadout" then
		return 1 - (1 - v33) * (1 - v33)
	elseif v34 == "inoutquad" or v34 == "quadinout" then
		if v33 < 0.5 then
			return v33 * 2 * v33
		else
			return 1 - (v33 * -2 + 2) ^ 2 / 2
		end
	elseif v34 == "incubic" or v34 == "cubicin" then
		return v33 ^ 3
	elseif v34 == "outcubic" or v34 == "cubicout" then
		return 1 - (1 - v33) ^ 3
	elseif v34 == "inoutcubic" or v34 == "cubicinout" then
		if v33 < 0.5 then
			return v33 ^ 3 * 4
		else
			return 1 - (v33 * -2 + 2) ^ 3 / 2
		end
	elseif v34 == "smoothstep" then
		return v33 * v33 * (3 - v33 * 2)
	else
		return v33
	end
end
local function v_u_49(p36) -- name: compileNumberSequence

		local v47 = v40.Envelope
		local v48 = v46 + math.abs(v47)

		["keypoints"] = v37,

end
local function v_u_65(p50, p51, p52) -- name: sampleNumberSequence
	local v53 = p50.keypoints
	if #v53 == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local v54 = math.clamp(p51, 0, 1)
	if v54 <= v53[1].time then
		local v55 = v53[1]
		return v55.value + v55.envelope * p52
	end
	for v56 = 2, #v53 do
		local v57 = v53[v56]
		if v54 <= v57.time then
			local v58 = v53[v56 - 1]
			local v59 = v57.time - v58.time
			local v60 = v59 <= 0 and 0 or (v54 - v58.time) / v59
			local v61 = v58.value
			local v62 = v61 + (v57.value - v61) * v60
			local v63 = v58.envelope
			return v62 + (v63 + (v57.envelope - v63) * v60) * p52
		end
	end

end

local function v_u_271(p218, p219) -- name: calculateEffectBounds
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_85
	local v220 = p219.BoundsSizeStuds
	if typeof(v220) == "Vector2" then
		local v221 = p219.BoundsSizeStuds
		if v221.X > 0 and v221.Y > 0 then
			local v222 = p219.BoundsCenterStuds
			local v223
			if typeof(v222) == "Vector2" then
				v223 = p219.BoundsCenterStuds
			else
				v223 = Vector2.zero
			end
			return v223, v221
		end
	end
	local v224 = Vector2.new((1 / 0), (1 / 0))
	local v225 = Vector2.new((-1 / 0), (-1 / 0))
	for _, v226 in p218 do
		local v227 = v_u_85(v226.origin, p219.Projection)
		local v228 = p219.Rotation
		if v228 ~= 0 then
			local v229 = math.rad(v228)
			local v230 = math.cos(v229)
			local v231 = math.sin(v229)
			v227 = Vector2.new(v227.X * v230 - v227.Y * v231, v227.X * v231 + v227.Y * v230)
		end
		local v232 = v226.lifetime.Min
		local v233 = v226.lifetime.Max
		local v234 = math.max(v232, v233)
		local v235 = v226.speed
		local v236 = v235.Min
		local v237 = math.abs(v236)
		local v238 = v235.Max
		local v239 = math.abs(v238)
		local v240 = math.max(v237, v239)
		local v241 = v226.acceleration.Magnitude
		local v242 = (v240 * v234 + 0.5 * v241 * v234 * v234) * p219.BoundsMotionScale
		local v243
		if v226.sizeStart == nil or v226.sizeEnd == nil then
			v243 = v226.size.maximum
		else
			local v244 = v226.sizeStart
			local v245 = math.abs(v244)
			local v246 = v226.sizeEnd
			local v247 = math.abs(v246)
			v243 = math.max(v245, v247)
		end
		local v248 = v226.squash.absoluteMaximum + 1
		local v249 = v243 * 0.5
		local v250 = v226.frameAspect
		local v251 = v242 + v249 * math.max(1, v250) * v248
		local v252 = math.max(0.001, v251)
		local v253 = Vector2.new
		local v254 = v224.X
		local v255 = v227.X - v252
		local v256 = math.min(v254, v255)
		local v257 = v224.Y
		local v258 = v227.Y - v252

		local v263 = v225.Y
		local v264 = v227.Y + v252
		v225 = v259(v262, (math.max(v263, v264)))
	end
	if v224.X == (1 / 0) then
		return Vector2.zero, Vector2.one
	end
	local v265 = v225 - v224
	local v266 = Vector2.new

	local v269 = v265.Y

end

local function v_u_359(p342, p343) -- name: getFlipbookFrame
	local v344 = p342.runtime.definition
	local v345 = v344.flipbookFrames
	if v345 <= 1 then
		return 0
	else
		local v346 = v344.flipbookMode
		local v347 = typeof(v346) ~= "EnumItem" and "Loop" or v346.Name
		if v347 == "OneShot" then
			local v348 = p343 * v345
			local v349 = math.floor(v348)
			local v350 = v345 - 1
			return math.clamp(v349, 0, v350)
		else
			local v351 = p342.age * p342.flipbookFPS
			local v352 = math.floor(v351)
			if v347 == "PingPong" then
				local v353 = v345 * 2 - 2
				local v354 = math.max(1, v353)
				local v355 = (v352 + p342.startFrame) % v354
				if v345 <= v355 then
					v355 = v354 - v355
				end
				return v355
			else
				if v347 ~= "Random" then
					return (v352 + p342.startFrame) % v345
				end
				local v356 = (p342.randomSeed + v352 * 92821) * 0.0001
				local v357 = math.sin(v356) * 43758.5453
				local v358 = math.abs(v357) % 1 * v345
				return math.floor(v358)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_435(p411, p412, p413) -- name: updateEmitterRuntime
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_341, (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_328
	local v414 = p412.definition
	p412.elapsed = p412.elapsed + p413
	if p412.started then
		p412.activeElapsed = p412.activeElapsed + p413
	else
		if p412.elapsed < v414.emitDelay then
			return
		end
		p412.started = true
		local v415 = p412.elapsed - v414.emitDelay
		p412.activeElapsed = math.max(0, v415)
		local v416 = p412.definition
		local v417
		if v416.timeScaleDuration <= 0 then
			v417 = v416.timeScaleEnd
		else
			local v418 = p412.activeElapsed / v416.timeScaleDuration
			local v419 = math.clamp(v418, 0, 1)
			local v420 = v_u_35(v416.timeScaleCurve, v419)
			local v421 = v416.timeScaleStart
			v417 = v421 + (v416.timeScaleEnd - v421) * v420
		end
		p412.currentTimeScale = v417
		if v414.emitCount > 0 then
			v_u_341(p411, p412, v414.emitCount)
		end
		if v414.emitDuration <= 0 then
			p412.finished = true
			return
		end
	end
	local v422 = p412.definition
	local v423
	if v422.timeScaleDuration <= 0 then
		v423 = v422.timeScaleEnd
	else
		local v424 = p412.activeElapsed / v422.timeScaleDuration
		local v425 = math.clamp(v424, 0, 1)
		local v426 = v_u_35(v422.timeScaleCurve, v425)
		local v427 = v422.timeScaleStart
		v423 = v427 + (v422.timeScaleEnd - v427) * v426
	end
	p412.currentTimeScale = v423
	if not (p412.finished or p411._emissionStopped) then
		if v414.emitDuration > 0 and p412.activeElapsed < v414.emitDuration then
			local v428 = p413 * p412.currentTimeScale
			p412.emissionAccumulator = p412.emissionAccumulator + v414.rate * v428 * p411._options.ParticleMultiplier
			local v429 = p412.emissionAccumulator
			local v430 = math.floor(v429)
			if v430 > 0 then
				p412.emissionAccumulator = p412.emissionAccumulator - v430
				local v431 = v_u_3.Settings.GlobalParticleLimit - v_u_8
				local v432 = p411._options.MaxParticles - #p411._particles
				local v433 = math.min(v431, v432)
				local v434 = math.max(0, v433)
				for _ = 1, math.min(v430, v434) do
					v_u_328(p411, p412)
				end
			end
		end
		if p412.activeElapsed >= v414.emitDuration then
			p412.finished = true
			p412.currentTimeScale = v414.timeScaleEnd
		end
	end
end

end

			else

			end

			end
		end
		v441 = v441.Parent
	end
	local v445 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not v445 then
		return true
	end
	local v446 = Vector2.zero
	local v447 = v445.ViewportSize
	local v448

local function v_u_455(p_u_450) -- name: finishPlayback
	if not (p_u_450._completed or p_u_450._destroyed) then
		p_u_450._completed = true
		p_u_450._playing = false
		local v_u_451 = p_u_450._completedEvent
		if v_u_451 then
			v_u_451:Fire()
		end
		local v_u_452 = p_u_450._options.OnComplete
		p_u_450._options.OnComplete = nil
		if typeof(v_u_452) == "function" then
			task.defer(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_452, (copy) p_u_450
				local v453, v454 = pcall(v_u_452, p_u_450)
				if not v453 then
					warn("GuiVFX OnComplete error:", v454)
				end
			end)
		end
		if p_u_450._options.AutoDestroyLayer and p_u_450._layer then
			pcall(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_450
				p_u_450._layer:Destroy()
			end)
			p_u_450._layer = nil
			p_u_450._target = nil
		end
		p_u_450._emitters = {}
		if v_u_451 then
			task.defer(function()

end
local function v_u_476(p456, p457) -- name: updatePlayback
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_134, (copy) v_u_455, (copy) v_u_437, (copy) v_u_449, (copy) v_u_435, (copy) v_u_302, (copy) v_u_130, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_410
	if p456._paused or (p456._completed or p456._destroyed) then
		return
	end
	local v458 = p456._target
	local v459 = p456._layer
	if not v458 or (not v459 or (v458.Parent == nil or v459.Parent == nil)) then
		p456:Destroy()
		return
	end
	p456._wallElapsed = p456._wallElapsed + p457
	if p456._options.MaxPlaybackDuration > 0 and p456._wallElapsed >= p456._options.MaxPlaybackDuration then
		v_u_134(p456)
		v_u_455(p456)
		return
	end
	if p456._options.PauseWhenHidden and not v_u_437(v458) then
		return
	end
	if p456._options.PauseWhenOffscreen and not v_u_449(v458) then
		return
	end
	local v460 = p457 * p456._timeScale
	for _, v461 in p456._emitters do
		v_u_435(p456, v461, v460)
	end
	local v462
	if #p456._particles > 0 then
		local v463 = p456._layer.AbsoluteSize
		local v464 = v_u_302(p456)
		p456._lastPixelsPerStud = v464
		v462 = {
			["frameSize"] = v463,
			["pixelsPerStud"] = v464
		}
		local v465 = p456._options.Position
		v462.originPixels = Vector2.new(v463.X * v465.X.Scale + v465.X.Offset, v463.Y * v465.Y.Scale + v465.Y.Offset) + p456._options.Offset
	else
		v462 = nil
	end
	for v466 = #p456._particles, 1, -1 do
		local v467 = p456._particles[v466]
		local v468 = v460 * v467.runtime.currentTimeScale
		v467.wallAge = v467.wallAge + p457
		v467.age = v467.age + v468
		if v467.age >= v467.lifetime or p456._options.MaxParticleWallLifetime > 0 and v467.wallAge >= p456._options.MaxParticleWallLifetime then
			local v469 = p456._particles
			v_u_130(v469[v466].sprite)
			local v470 = v_u_8 - 1
			v_u_8 = math.max(0, v470)
			local v471 = #v469
			if v466 ~= v471 then
				v469[v466] = v469[v471]
			end
			v469[v471] = nil
		else
			v467.velocity = v467.velocity + v467.acceleration * v468
			if v467.drag > 0 then
				local v472 = v467.velocity
				local v473 = -v467.drag * v468
				v467.velocity = v472 * math.exp(v473)
			end
			v467.position = v467.position + v467.velocity * v468
			v467.rotation = v467.rotation + v467.rotSpeed * v468
			v_u_410(p456, v467, v462)
		end
	end
	local v474
	if p456._emissionStopped then
		v474 = true
		::l38::
		if v474 and #p456._particles == 0 then
			v_u_455(p456)
		end
		return
	else
		for _, v475 in p456._emitters do
			if not v475.finished then
				v474 = false
				goto l38
			end
		end
		v474 = true
		goto l38
	end
end

		end

end

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_270, p_u_271, p_u_272) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_270, (copy) p_u_271, (copy) p_u_272
		local v_u_273 = p_u_270:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_273.Transparency = 1
		p_u_271.Parent = v_u_273.Parent
		p_u_271.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_271.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_271.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_271.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_271.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_274 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]
			p_u_270:addToJanitor(v_u_273:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v_u_274):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_274, (copy) v_u_273
				p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]
			end))
		end
		local function v_u_279() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271
			local v275 = 0
			local v276 = 0
			for _, v277 in p_u_271.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v278 = string.lower(v277.Name)
				if v278 == "digit" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				elseif (v278 == "prefix" or (v278 == "suffix" or v278 == "comma")) and v277.Text ~= "" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				end
			end
			return v275, v276
		end
		local function v_u_288() -- name: adjustSize
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_279, (ref) p_u_270, (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_273
			local v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			if v281 < 18 then
				p_u_270:setLabel(p_u_271.Value)
			end
			local v282 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
			while v280 < v282 and p_u_270.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if v281 > 0 and v281 < 8 then
					p_u_271.TextSize = v_u_273.TextSize
					break
				end
				local v283 = p_u_271
				v283.TextSize = v283.TextSize + 1
				v282 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
				v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			end
			local v284 = v_u_273.Parent
			if v284 then
				v284 = v284.Parent
			end
			local v285
			if v284 == nil then
				v285 = 0
			elseif v284.IconImage.Visible == true then
				v285 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X + v_u_273.Parent.Parent.IconImage.AbsoluteSize.X
			else
				v285 = v284.AbsoluteSize.X
			end
			while v285 < v280 and p_u_270.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if v281 < 8 and v281 > 0 then
					p_u_271.TextSize = v_u_273.TextSize
					return
				end
				local v286 = p_u_271
				v286.TextSize = v286.TextSize - 1
				local v287 = v_u_273.Parent
				if v287 then
					v287 = v287.Parent
				end
				if v287 == nil then
					v285 = 0
				elseif v287.IconImage.Visible == true then
					v285 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X + v_u_273.Parent.Parent.IconImage.AbsoluteSize.X
				else
					v285 = v287.AbsoluteSize.X
				end
				v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			end
		end
		p_u_270:addToJanitor(p_u_271.Frame.ChildAdded:Connect(v_u_288))
		p_u_270:addToJanitor(p_u_271.Frame.ChildRemoved:Connect(v_u_288))
		p_u_270:addToJanitor(p_u_270.iconAdded:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_288
			task.wait(1)
			v_u_288()
		end))
		p_u_270:updateParent()
		p_u_271.Name = "LabelSpinner"
		p_u_271.Prefix = "$"
		p_u_271.Commas = true
		p_u_271.Decimals = 0
		p_u_271.Duration = 0.25
		p_u_271.Value = 10
		task.wait(0.2)
		local v289 = p_u_272
		if typeof(v289) == "function" then
			p_u_272()
		end
	end)
	return p_u_270
end

		p290:clearNotices()
		if p290.parentIconUID then
			p290:leave()
		end
		p290.isDestroyed = true
		p290.janitor:clean()
		v_u_15.iconRemoved:Fire(p290)
	end
end
v_u_15.Destroy = v_u_15.destroy
return v_u_15

-- ============================================================
-- Script Path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").UserGenerated.Collections.DeepCopy
-- Executor: Delta
-- ============================================================
function DeepCopyWithMetatables(p1, p2) -- name: DeepCopyWithMetatables
	if type(p1) ~= "table" then
		return p1

	["Storable"] = function(p359, p360) -- name: Storable
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_382
		if type(p359) == "boolean" then
			return p359
		end
		if type(p359) == "number" then
			return p359
		end
		if type(p359) == "string" then
			if not utf8.len(p359) then
				error("UTF8", 2)
				return p359
			end
		else
			if type(p359) == "buffer" then
				return p359
			end
			if type(p359) == "table" then
				if type(p359) ~= "table" then
					error("table", 2)
				end
				if getmetatable(p359) ~= nil then
					error("metatable", 2)
				end
				local v361 = p360 or {}
				if v361[p359] then
					error("Loop", 2)
				end
				v361[p359] = true
				local v362 = rawlen(p359)
				if v362 <= 0 then
					for v363, v364 in pairs(p359) do
						if type(v363) ~= "string" then
							error(("KeyString $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v363))))), 2)
						end
						if not utf8.len(v363) then
							error(("KeyUTF8 $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v363))))), 2)
						end
						local v365, v366 = pcall(v_u_382.Storable, v364, v361)
						if not v365 then
							local v367 = tostring(v366)
							local v368, v369 = string.match(v367, "^(.*:%d+): (.+)$")
							if v368 then
								v367 = v369 or v367
							end
							local v370, v371 = string.match(v367, "^(.+) $(%[.+)$")
							if v370 then
								if not v371 then
									v370 = v367
								end
							else
								v370 = v367
							end
							error(("%* $%*"):format(v370, (("[%*]%*"):format(v_u_9(v363), v371 or ""))), 2)
						end
					end
					return p359
				end
				local v372 = 0
				for v373, v374 in pairs(p359) do

			local v64 = v_u_1.delay(1)
			expect(v64:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6()
			expect(v64:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(1)
			expect(v64:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
		end)
		it("should allow for delays to be cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v_u_65 = v_u_1.delay(2)
			v_u_1.delay(1):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_65
				v_u_65:cancel()
			end)
			expect(v_u_65:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6()
			expect(v_u_65:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(1)
			expect(v_u_65:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			v_u_6(1)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.resolve", function()

		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise:andThen", function()

		end)
		it("should run andThens on a new thread", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

		it("should chain onto resolved promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_7

				v_u_82 = v86

				v_u_84 = v_u_84 + 1
			end)
			expect(v_u_84).to.equal(0)

			expect(#v88._values).to.equal(0)
		end)
		it("should chain onto rejected promises", function()

		it("should reject on error in callback", function()

			local v99 = expect

			local v103 = expect
			local v104 = v98._values[1]

		end)
		it("should chain onto asynchronously resolved promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

		it("should chain onto asynchronously rejected promises", function()

		it("should propagate errors through multiple levels", function()

			local v_u_123 = nil

		it("should not call queued callbacks from a cancelled sub-promise", function()

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should mark promises as cancelled and not resolve or reject them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_132 = 0
			local v_u_133 = 0
			local v134 = v_u_1.new(function() end):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_132
				v_u_132 = v_u_132 + 1
			end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_133
				v_u_133 = v_u_133 + 1
			end)
			v134:cancel()
			v134:cancel()
			expect(v_u_132).to.equal(0)
			expect(v_u_133).to.equal(1)
			expect(v134:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should call the cancellation hook once", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_135 = 0
			local v137 = v_u_1.new(function(_, _, p136)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_135
				p136(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_135
					v_u_135 = v_u_135 + 1
				end)
			end)
			v137:cancel()
			v137:cancel()
			expect(v_u_135).to.equal(1)
		end)
		it("should propagate cancellations", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v138 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v139 = v138:andThen()
			local v140 = v138:andThen()
			expect(v138:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v140:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v139:cancel()
			expect(v138:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v140:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v140:cancel()
			expect(v138:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v140:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should affect downstream promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v141 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v142 = v141:andThen()
			v141:cancel()
			expect(v142:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should track consumers", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_143 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v144 = v_u_1.resolve()
			local v_u_145 = v144:andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_143
				return v_u_143
			end)
			local v147 = v_u_1.new(function(p146)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_145
				p146(v_u_145)
			end)
			local v148 = v147:andThen(function() end)
			expect(v_u_145._parent).to.never.equal(v144)
			expect(v147._parent).to.never.equal(v_u_145)
			expect(v147._consumers[v148]).to.be.ok()
			expect(v148._parent).to.equal(v147)
		end)
		it("should cancel resolved pending promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_149 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v151 = v_u_1.new(function(p150)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_149
				p150(v_u_149)
			end):finally(function() end)
			v151:cancel()
			expect(v_u_149._status).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v151._status).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should close the promise thread", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v_u_152 = 0
			v_u_1.new(function()

	end)
	describe("Promise:finally", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should be called upon resolve, reject, or cancel", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_153 = 0
			local function v154() -- name: finally
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_153
				v_u_153 = v_u_153 + 1
			end
			v_u_1.new(function(p155, _)
				p155()
			end):finally(v154)
			v_u_1.resolve():andThen(function() end):finally(v154):finally(v154)
			v_u_1.reject():finally(v154)
			v_u_1.new(function() end):finally(v154):cancel()
			expect(v_u_153).to.equal(5)
		end)
		it("should not forward return values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_156 = nil
			v_u_1.resolve(2):finally(function()
				return 1
			end):andThen(function(p157)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_156
				v_u_156 = p157
			end)
			expect(v_u_156).to.equal(2)
		end)
		it("should not consume rejections", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_158 = false
			local v_u_159 = false
			v_u_1.reject(5):finally(function()
				return 42
			end):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_159
				v_u_159 = true
			end):catch(function(p160)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_158
				v_u_158 = true
				expect(p160).to.equal(5)
			end)
			expect(v_u_158).to.equal(true)
			expect(v_u_159).to.equal(false)
		end)
		it("should wait for returned promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_161 = nil
			local v163 = v_u_1.reject("foo"):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_161
				return v_u_1.new(function(p162)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_161
					v_u_161 = p162
				end)
			end)
			expect(v163:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_161()
			expect(v163:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			local _, v164 = v163:_unwrap()
			expect(v164).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should reject with a returned rejected promise\'s value", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_165 = nil
			local v167 = v_u_1.reject("foo"):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_165
				return v_u_1.new(function(_, p166)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_165
					v_u_165 = p166
				end)
			end)
			expect(v167:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_165("bar")
			expect(v167:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			local _, v168 = v167:_unwrap()
			expect(v168).to.equal("bar")
		end)
		it("should reject when handler errors", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_169 = {}
			local v170, v171 = v_u_1.reject("bar"):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_169
				error(v_u_169)
			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v170).to.equal(false)
			expect(v171).to.equal(v_u_169)
		end)
		it("should not prevent cancellation", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v172 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v_u_173 = false
			v172:finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_173
				v_u_173 = true
			end)
			v172:andThen(function() end):cancel()
			expect(v172:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v_u_173).to.equal(true)
		end)
		it("should propagate cancellation downwards", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_174 = false
			local v175 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v176 = v175:finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_174
				v_u_174 = true
			end)
			v175:cancel()
			expect(v175:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v176:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v_u_174).to.equal(true)
			expect(false).to.equal(false)
		end)
		it("should propagate cancellation upwards", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_177 = false
			local v178 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v179 = v178:finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_177
				v_u_177 = true
			end)
			v179:cancel()
			expect(v178:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v179:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v_u_177).to.equal(true)
			expect(false).to.equal(false)
		end)
		it("should cancel returned promise if cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_180 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v_u_1.resolve():finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_180
				return v_u_180
			end):cancel()
			expect(v_u_180:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.all", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_7
		it("should error if given something other than a table", function()

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			end).to.throw()

		it("should resolve instantly with an empty table if given no promises", function()

					{}

		end)
		it("should wait for all promises to be resolved and return their values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_1

			local v_u_186 = {}
			local v187 = {}

				v187[v_u_188] = v_u_1.new(function(p189)
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_186, (copy) v_u_188, (copy) v_u_185
					v_u_186[v_u_188] = { p189, v_u_185[v_u_188] }
				end)
			end
			local v190 = v_u_1.all(v187)
			for _, v191 in ipairs(v_u_186) do
				expect(v190:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
				v191[1](v191[2])
			end
			local v192, v193 = v_u_7(v190:_unwrap())

			expect(v192).to.equal(2)
			expect(v194).to.equal(true)

			end
		end)
		it("should reject if any individual promise rejected", function()

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_197

				v_u_198 = p201

	describe("Promise.fold", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should return the initial value in a promise when the list is empty", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v236 = {}
			local v237 = v_u_1.fold({}, function()
				error("should not be called")
			end, v236)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v237)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v237:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v237:expect()).to.equal(v236)
		end)
		it("should accept promises in the list", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_238 = nil
			local v242 = v_u_1.fold({ v_u_1.new(function(p239)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_238
					v_u_238 = p239
				end), 2, 3 }, function(p240, p241)
				return p240 + p241
			end, 0)
			v_u_238(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v242)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v242:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v242:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should always return a promise even if the list or reducer don\'t use them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v246 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p243, p244, p245)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p245 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p243 + p244)
				else
					return p243 + p244
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v246)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v246:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v246:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v246:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v250 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p247, p248, p249)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p249 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.reject("foo")
				else
					return p247 + p248
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v250)).to.equal(true)
			local v251, v252 = v250:awaitStatus()
			expect(v251).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v252).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should return the first canceled promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_253 = nil
			local v257 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p254, p255, p256)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_253, (ref) v_u_1
				if p256 == 1 then
					return p254 + p255
				end
				if p256 == 2 then
					v_u_253 = v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p254 + p255)
					return v_u_253
				end
				error("this should not run if the promise is cancelled")
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v257)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v257:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_253:cancel()

		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise.some", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			expect(v304:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

			local v_u_305 = nil
			local v307 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.new(function(_, p306)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_305
					v_u_305 = p306
				end) }, 2)
			expect(v307:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

			expect(v307:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)

		it("should cancel pending Promises once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_308 = nil
			local v309 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function(p310)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_308
				v_u_308 = p310
			end)
			local v312 = v_u_1.some({ v309, v311, v_u_1.resolve() }, 2)
			expect(v312:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_308()
			expect(v312:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)

		it("should return an empty array if amount is 0", function()

		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v315 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v315:andThen(function() end)
			local v316 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v315 }

		describe("Promise.any", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				local v317 = v_u_1.any({ v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.resolve(1) })
				expect(v317:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

			end)
			it("should error if all are rejected", function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				expect(v_u_1.any({ v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.reject() }):getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			end)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.allSettled", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve with an array of PromiseStatuses", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_318 = nil
			local v320 = v_u_1.allSettled({
				v_u_1.resolve(),
				v_u_1.reject(),
				v_u_1.resolve(),

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_318
					v_u_318 = p319
				end)
			})
			expect(v320:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_318()
			expect(v320:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v320._values[1][1]).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v320._values[1][2]).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v320._values[1][3]).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v320._values[1][4]).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
		end)
		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v321 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v321:andThen(function() end)
			local v322 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v321 }
			v_u_1.allSettled(v322):cancel()
			expect(v322[1]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v322[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v322[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise:await", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should return the correct values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v323, v324, v325, v326, v327 = v_u_1.resolve(5, 6, nil, 7):await()

			expect(v324).to.equal(5)
			expect(v325).to.equal(6)
			expect(v326).to.equal(nil)
			expect(v327).to.equal(7)
		end)
		it("should work if yielding is needed", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v_u_328 = false
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_328
				local _, v329 = v_u_1.delay(1):await()
				expect((type(v329))).to.equal("number")
				v_u_328 = true
			end)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v_u_328).to.equal(true)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise:expect", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should throw the correct values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v330 = {}
			local v_u_331 = v_u_1.reject(v330)
			local v332, v333 = pcall(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_331
				v_u_331:expect()
			end)
			expect(v332).to.equal(false)

		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise:now", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve if the Promise is resolved", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v334, v335 = v_u_1.resolve("foo"):now():_unwrap()
			expect(v334).to.equal(true)
			expect(v335).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should reject if the Promise is not resolved", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v336, v337 = v_u_1.new(function() end):now():_unwrap()
			expect(v336).to.equal(false)
			expect(v_u_1.Error.isKind(v337, "NotResolvedInTime")).to.equal(true)
		end)
		it("should reject with a custom rejection value", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v338, v339 = v_u_1.new(function() end):now("foo"):_unwrap()
			expect(v338).to.equal(false)
			expect(v339).to.equal("foo")
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.each", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should iterate", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v340, v341 = v_u_1.each({
				"foo",
				"bar",
				"baz",
				"qux"
			}, function(...)
				return { ... }
			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v340).to.equal(true)
			expect(v341[1][1]).to.equal("foo")
			expect(v341[1][2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v341[2][1]).to.equal("bar")
			expect(v341[2][2]).to.equal(2)
			expect(v341[3][1]).to.equal("baz")
			expect(v341[3][2]).to.equal(3)
			expect(v341[4][1]).to.equal("qux")
			expect(v341[4][2]).to.equal(4)
		end)
		it("should iterate serially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_342 = {}
			local v_u_343 = {}
			local v349 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(p_u_344, p345)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_343, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_342
				v_u_343[p345] = (v_u_343[p345] or 0) + 1
				return v_u_1.new(function(p_u_346)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_342, (copy) p_u_344
					local v347 = v_u_342
					local function v348()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_346, (ref) p_u_344
						p_u_346(p_u_344:upper())
					end
					table.insert(v347, v348)
				end)
			end)
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_342).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[2]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_342, 1)()
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_342).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[3]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_342, 1)()
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v_u_343[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_343[3]).to.equal(1)
			table.remove(v_u_342, 1)()
			expect(v349:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			local v350 = expect
			local v351 = v349._values[1]
			v350((type(v351))).to.equal("table")
			local v352 = expect
			local v353 = v349._values[2]
			v352((type(v353))).to.equal("nil")
			local v354 = v349._values[1]
			expect(v354[1]).to.equal("FOO")
			expect(v354[2]).to.equal("BAR")
			expect(v354[3]).to.equal("BAZ")
		end)
		it("should reject with the value if the predicate promise rejects", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v355 = v_u_1.each({ 1, 2, 3 }, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				return v_u_1.reject("foobar")
			end)
			expect(v355:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v355._values[1]).to.equal("foobar")
		end)
		it("should allow Promises to be in the list and wait when it gets to them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_356 = nil
			local v358 = { (v_u_1.new(function(p357)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_356
					v_u_356 = p357
				end)) }

				return p359 * 2
			end)
			expect(v360:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_356(2)
			expect(v360:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v360._values[1][1]).to.equal(4)
		end)
		it("should reject with the value if a Promise from the list rejects", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_361 = false
			local v362 = v_u_1.each({ 1, 2, v_u_1.reject("foobar") }, function(_)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_361
				v_u_361 = true
				return "never"
			end)
			expect(v362:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v362._values[1]).to.equal("foobar")
			expect(v_u_361).to.equal(false)
		end)
		it("should reject immediately if there\'s a cancelled Promise in the list initially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v363 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v363:cancel()
			local v_u_364 = false
			local v365 = v_u_1.each({ 1, 2, v363 }, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_364
				v_u_364 = true
			end)
			expect(v365:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v_u_364).to.equal(false)
			expect(v365._values[1].kind).to.equal(v_u_1.Error.Kind.AlreadyCancelled)
		end)
		it("should stop iteration if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_366 = {}
			local v368 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(_, p367)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_366, (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_366[p367] = (v_u_366[p367] or 0) + 1
				return v_u_1.new(function() end)
			end)
			expect(v368:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v_u_366[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_366[2]).to.never.be.ok()
			v368:cancel()
			expect(v368:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v_u_366[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_366[2]).to.never.be.ok()
		end)
		it("should cancel the Promise returned from the predicate if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_369 = nil
			v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(_, _)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_369, (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_369 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
				return v_u_369
			end):cancel()
			expect(v_u_369:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should cancel Promises in the list if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v370 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v_u_1.each({ v370 }, function() end):cancel()

		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.retry", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should retry N times", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_371 = 0
			local v373 = v_u_1.retry(function(p372)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_371, (ref) v_u_1
				expect(p372).to.equal("foo")
				v_u_371 = v_u_371 + 1
				if v_u_371 == 5 then
					return v_u_1.resolve("ok")
				else
					return v_u_1.reject("fail")
				end
			end, 5, "foo")
			expect(v373:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v373._values[1]).to.equal("ok")
		end)
		it("should reject if threshold is exceeded", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v374 = v_u_1.retry(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				return v_u_1.reject("fail")
			end, 5)
			expect(v374:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v374._values[1]).to.equal("fail")
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.retryWithDelay", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should retry after a delay", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v_u_375 = 0
			local v377 = v_u_1.retryWithDelay(function(p376)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_375, (ref) v_u_1
				expect(p376).to.equal("foo")
				v_u_375 = v_u_375 + 1
				if v_u_375 == 3 then
					return v_u_1.resolve("ok")
				else
					return v_u_1.reject("fail")
				end
			end, 3, 10, "foo")
			expect(v_u_375).to.equal(1)
			v_u_6(11)
			expect(v_u_375).to.equal(2)
			v_u_6(11)
			expect(v_u_375).to.equal(3)
			expect(v377:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v377._values[1]).to.equal("ok")
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.fromEvent", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should convert a Promise into an event", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v378 = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			local v379 = v_u_1.fromEvent(v378.Event)
			expect(v379:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v378:Fire("foo")
			expect(v379:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v379._values[1]).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should convert a Promise into an event with the predicate", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v380 = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			local v382 = v_u_1.fromEvent(v380.Event, function(p381)
				return p381 == "foo"
			end)
			expect(v382:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v380:Fire("bar")
			expect(v382:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v380:Fire("foo")
			expect(v382:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v382._values[1]).to.equal("foo")
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.is", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should work with current version", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v383 = v_u_1.resolve(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v383)).to.equal(true)
		end)
		it("should work with any object with an andThen", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(v_u_1.is({
				["andThen"] = function() -- name: andThen
					return 1
				end
			})).to.equal(true)
		end)
		it("should work with older promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v384 = {
				["prototype"] = {}
			}
			v384.__index = v384.prototype
			function v384.prototype.andThen(_) -- name: andThen end
			local v385 = setmetatable({}, v384)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v385)).to.equal(true)
		end)
	end)
end

function v_u_18.dispatch(p93, p94, p95, p96, p97, p98) -- name: dispatch
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_16
	local v99 = p93.ClassName
	v_u_25(p93, p94)
	if v99 == "ParticleEmitter" then
		v_u_18.particle(p93, p94, p95, p96, p98)
		return
	elseif v99 == "Beam" then
		v_u_18.beam(p93, p94, p98)
		return
	elseif v99 == "Trail" then
		v_u_18.trail(p93)
		return
	elseif v99 == "Sound" then
		v_u_18.sound(p93, p94)
		return
	elseif v99 == "RayValue" then
		if p93:HasTag(v_u_16.SCREENSHAKE_TAG) then
			v_u_18.camera_shake(p93, p94)
			return
		elseif p93:HasTag(v_u_16.ATTRIBUTE_TWEENER_TAG) then
			v_u_18.attribute_tweener(p93, p94)
		elseif not p93:HasTag(v_u_16.PROPERTY_RANDOMIZER_TAG) then
			if p93:HasTag(v_u_16.ATTRIBUTE_RANDOMIZER_TAG) then
				return
			end
			v_u_18.property_tweener(p93, p94)
		end
	elseif p93:HasTag(v_u_16.BEZIER_TAG) then
		v_u_18.bezier(p93, p94)
		return
	elseif p93:HasTag(v_u_16.LIGHTNING_TAG) then
		v_u_18.lightning(p93, p94)
		return
	elseif v99 == "Model" then
		if v_u_16.isMeshVFX(p93) then
			v_u_18.mesh(p93, p94, p97, p98)
		else
			v_u_18.spin(p93, p94)
		end
	else
		local v100 = v99 == "Part" and v_u_16.findFirstClassWithTag(p93, "Attachment", v_u_16.SHOCKWAVE_TAG)
		if v100 then
			local v101 = p93.Parent and (p93.Parent.Name or "") or ""
			if v101 == "Rings" then
				v_u_18.shockwave_ring(v100, p93, p94)
				return
			end
			if v101 == "Debris" then
				v_u_18.shockwave_debris(v100, p93, p94)
				return
			end
			if v101 == "Lines" then
				v_u_18.shockwave_line(v100, p93, p94)
			end
		end
		return
	end
end

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)

	end

end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22

function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager

		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then

				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()

				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")

			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then

			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37

					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

		v_u_95 = 0
	end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22

				v_u_20 = nil

		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5

	local v100 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

	if p39 == nil or p40 == nil then

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_17[p_u_42] ~= nil then
		for _, v44 in pairs(v_u_17[p_u_42].connections) do
			v44:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_17[p_u_42] = {}
	v_u_17[p_u_42].count = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].connections = {}
	local v_u_45 = true
	local v46, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_45
		v_u_45 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations

	v_u_45 = not v46 and true or v_u_45
	local v47 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_42)

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43

		local v50 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
		local v51 = v47.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v50, v51:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
		end))
		for _, v52 in pairs(v47:GetChildren()) do
			if v52:IsA("Animation") then
				local v53 = v52:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v54 = v53 == nil and 1 or v53.Value
				v_u_17[p_u_42].count = v_u_17[p_u_42].count + 1
				local v55 = v_u_17[p_u_42].count
				v_u_17[p_u_42][v55] = {}
				v_u_17[p_u_42][v55].anim = v52
				v_u_17[p_u_42][v55].weight = v54
				v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v_u_17[p_u_42][v55].weight
				local v56 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
				local v57 = v52.Changed
				table.insert(v56, v57:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
				end))
				local v58 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
				local v59 = v52.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v58, v59:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
				end))
				local v60 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
				local v61 = v52.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v60, v61:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_17[p_u_42].count <= 0 then
		for v62, v63 in pairs(p_u_43) do
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62] = {}
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].anim.Name = p_u_42
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].anim.AnimationId = v63.id

			v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v63.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v64 in pairs(v_u_17) do
		for v65 = 1, v64.count do
			if v_u_16[v64[v65].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v64[v65].anim)
				v_u_16[v64[v65].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v100 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v100 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v100
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v102 = p101 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v103 = 0.0001
	local v104 = 0.0001
	local v105 = 1
	if v102 <= 0.5 then
		v105 = v102 / 0.5
		v103 = 1

		v104 = (v102 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v103 = 1 - v104

		v104 = 1
	end

	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v104)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v105)

end

function rollAnimation(p112) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v113 = math.random(1, v_u_17[p112].totalWeight)
	local v114 = 1
	while v_u_17[p112][v114].weight < v113 do
		v113 = v113 - v_u_17[p112][v114].weight
		v114 = v114 + 1
	end
	return v114
end

function onRunning(p140) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_88, (ref) v_u_97, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_9
	local v141 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_89 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v142 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v143 = v_u_89.SensedPart
		if v143 then
			local v144 = v143:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_89.HitFrame.Position)
			local v145 = v142.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v146 = v145.X - v144.X
			local v147 = v145.Z - v144.Z
			local v148 = Vector3.new(v146, 0, v147).Magnitude
			local v149 = v_u_88.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v149 < 0.1 then
				v148 = 0
				v149 = 0
			elseif v149 > 1 then
				v149 = 1
			end
			p140 = v148 * v149
		end
	end
	local v150 = v_u_97
	if v150 then
		v150 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v150 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v141 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v141 < p140 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p140 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_19[v_u_9] == nil and not v_u_97 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p158) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_157, (ref) v_u_96, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_94, (ref) v_u_95, (ref) v_u_130
	local v159 = p158 - v_u_157
	v_u_157 = p158
	if v_u_96 > 0 then
		v_u_96 = v_u_96 - v159
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_96 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v160 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v160 and v160:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v161 = getToolAnim(v160)
		if v161 then
			v_u_94 = v161.Value
			v161.Parent = nil
			v_u_95 = p158 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_95 < p158 then
			v_u_95 = 0
			v_u_94 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_94 = "None"
		v_u_130 = nil
		v_u_95 = 0
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if v_u_20 then
		v_u_20:Disconnect()
		v_u_20 = nil

	if v_u_21 then
		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil
	end
	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor

		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()

	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)

function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then

	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30

function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2

		for _, v44 in pairs(v_u_17[p_u_42].connections) do
			v44:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_17[p_u_42] = {}
	v_u_17[p_u_42].count = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].connections = {}
	local v_u_45 = true
	local v46, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_45
		v_u_45 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations

	v_u_45 = not v46 and true or v_u_45
	local v47 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_42)

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
