function stepAnimate(p158) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_157, (ref) v_u_96, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_94, (ref) v_u_95, (ref) v_u_130
	local v159 = p158 - v_u_157
	v_u_157 = p158
	if v_u_96 > 0 then
		v_u_96 = v_u_96 - v159
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_96 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v160 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v160 and v160:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v161 = getToolAnim(v160)
		if v161 then
			v_u_94 = v161.Value
			v161.Parent = nil
			v_u_95 = p158 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_95 < p158 then
			v_u_95 = 0
			v_u_94 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_94 = "None"
		v_u_130 = nil
		v_u_95 = 0
	end
end

		return v42[1].Value
	end
	if v42[#v42].Time <= p41 then
		return v42[#v42].Value

		end

	return v43.Value:Lerp(v44.Value, v47)
end

local v_u_28 = {

		local v4 = buffer.create(#p3 * 8)
		for v5, v6 in p3 do
			local v7 = (v5 - 1) * 8
			buffer.writef64(v4, v7, v6)
		end
		return v4
	end,

		if typeof(p8) == "string" then
			p8 = buffer.fromstring(p8) or p8
		end

		for v10 = 0, buffer.len(p8) / 8 - 1 do
			local v11 = v10 * 8
			local v12 = buffer.readf64(p8, v11)
			table.insert(v9, v12)
		end
		return v9
	end,
	["isLocalFlipbook"] = function(p13) -- name: isLocalFlipbook
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
		if not v_u_1:IsStudio() then
			return false
		end
		for _, v14 in v_u_2:GetTags(p13) do
			if v14:match("^_local_flipbook_") then
				return true
			end
		end

	end,

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_28
		return v_u_28.isLocalFlipbook(p15) and "rbxtemp://" or "rbxassetid://"
	end,

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_28

			local v17 = p16:GetAttribute("FlipbookTextures")

				end

			end

		end
	end,
	["getChangeDuration"] = function(p19) -- name: getChangeDuration
		local v20 = p19.duration
		if p19.ref:GetAttribute("SyncDuration") then
			v20 = p19.effectDuration
		end

	end,

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_28
		local v_u_22 = v_u_28.getTexturePrefix(p_u_21.ref)

			local v25 = #p_u_21.frames * p23
			local v26 = math.round(v25)

return {
	["fromLinear"] = function(p1) -- name: fromLinear
		local v2 = Color3.new
		local v3 = p1.R
		local v4
		if v3 < 0.0031308 then
			v4 = v3 * 12.92
		else
			v4 = v3 ^ 0.4166666666666667 * 1.055 - 0.055
		end
		local v5 = p1.G
		local v6
		if v5 < 0.0031308 then
			v6 = v5 * 12.92
		else
			v6 = v5 ^ 0.4166666666666667 * 1.055 - 0.055
		end
		local v7 = p1.B
		local v8
		if v7 < 0.0031308 then
			v8 = v7 * 12.92
		else
			v8 = v7 ^ 0.4166666666666667 * 1.055 - 0.055
		end
		return v2(v4, v6, v8)
	end,
	["toLinear"] = function(p9) -- name: toLinear
		local v10 = Color3.new
		local v11 = p9.R
		local v12
		if v11 < 0.04045 then
			v12 = v11 / 12.92
		else
			v12 = ((v11 + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
		end
		local v13 = p9.G
		local v14
		if v13 < 0.04045 then
			v14 = v13 / 12.92
		else
			v14 = ((v13 + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
		end
		local v15 = p9.B
		local v16
		if v15 < 0.04045 then
			v16 = v15 / 12.92
		else
			v16 = ((v15 + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
		end
		return v10(v12, v14, v16)
	end
}

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()

		it("should wait for all promises to be resolved and return their values", function()

	describe("Promise.fold", function()

				else
					return p243 + p244

					return v_u_1.reject("foo")

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_305

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_308
				v_u_308 = p310
			end)

			expect(v312:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

	beforeAll(function()

	end)
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if v_u_20 then
		v_u_20:Disconnect()
		v_u_20 = nil
	end
	if v_u_21 then
		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil
	end
	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p39, p40) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p39 == nil or p40 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v41 = 1, p39.count do
		if p39[v41].anim.AnimationId == p40.AnimationId then
			return v41
		end
	end
	return 0
end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_17[p_u_42] ~= nil then
		for _, v44 in pairs(v_u_17[p_u_42].connections) do
			v44:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_17[p_u_42] = {}
	v_u_17[p_u_42].count = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].connections = {}
	local v_u_45 = true
	local v46, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_45
		v_u_45 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations
	end)
	v_u_45 = not v46 and true or v_u_45
	local v47 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_42)
	if v_u_45 and v47 ~= nil then
		local v48 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
		local v49 = v47.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
		end))
		local v50 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
		local v51 = v47.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v50, v51:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
		end))
		for _, v52 in pairs(v47:GetChildren()) do
			if v52:IsA("Animation") then
				local v53 = v52:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v54 = v53 == nil and 1 or v53.Value
				v_u_17[p_u_42].count = v_u_17[p_u_42].count + 1
				local v55 = v_u_17[p_u_42].count
				v_u_17[p_u_42][v55] = {}
				v_u_17[p_u_42][v55].anim = v52
				v_u_17[p_u_42][v55].weight = v54
				v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v_u_17[p_u_42][v55].weight
				local v56 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
				local v57 = v52.Changed
				table.insert(v56, v57:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
				end))
				local v58 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
				local v59 = v52.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v58, v59:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
				end))
				local v60 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
				local v61 = v52.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v60, v61:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_17[p_u_42].count <= 0 then
		for v62, v63 in pairs(p_u_43) do
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62] = {}
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].anim.Name = p_u_42
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].anim.AnimationId = v63.id
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v62].weight = v63.weight
			v_u_17[p_u_42].count = v_u_17[p_u_42].count + 1
			v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v63.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v64 in pairs(v_u_17) do
		for v65 = 1, v64.count do
			if v_u_16[v64[v65].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v64[v65].anim)
				v_u_16[v64[v65].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if v_u_20 then
		v_u_20:Disconnect()
		v_u_20 = nil
	end
	if v_u_21 then
		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil
	end
	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

				local v61 = v52.ChildRemoved

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v100 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v100 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v100
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v102 = p101 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v103 = 0.0001
	local v104 = 0.0001
	local v105 = 1
	if v102 <= 0.5 then
		v105 = v102 / 0.5
		v103 = 1
	elseif v102 < 1 then
		v104 = (v102 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v103 = 1 - v104

		v104 = 1
	end

	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v104)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v105)

end

function onRunning(p140) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_88, (ref) v_u_97, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_9
	local v141 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_89 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v142 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v143 = v_u_89.SensedPart
		if v143 then
			local v144 = v143:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_89.HitFrame.Position)
			local v145 = v142.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v146 = v145.X - v144.X
			local v147 = v145.Z - v144.Z
			local v148 = Vector3.new(v146, 0, v147).Magnitude
			local v149 = v_u_88.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v149 < 0.1 then
				v148 = 0
				v149 = 0
			elseif v149 > 1 then
				v149 = 1
			end
			p140 = v148 * v149
		end
	end
	local v150 = v_u_97
	if v150 then
		v150 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v150 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v141 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v141 < p140 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)

local function v_u_77(p69) -- name: parse_duration
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_68
	local v70 = 0
	for _, v71 in string.split(p69, " ") do
		local v72, v73 = string.match(v71, "(.-)[%s]?([A-z]+)$")
		if v72 and v73 then
			local v74 = v_u_68[v73]
			if not v74 then
				error(("\"%*\" is not a valid suffix"):format(v74), 0)
			end
			local v75 = tonumber(v72)
			if not v75 then
				error(("could not convert \"%*\" into a duration"):format(v71), 0)
			end
			v70 = v70 + v75 * v74
		else
			local v76 = tonumber(v71)
			if not v76 then
				error(("could not convert \"%*\" into a duration"):format(v71), 0)
			end
			v70 = v70 + v76
		end
	end
	return v70
end

local function v_u_28(p22, ...) -- name: determine_overload
	if #p22 == 1 then
		return p22[1]
	end
	local v23 = table.clone(p22)
	for v24 = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local v25 = select(v24, ...)
		for v26 = #v23, 1, -1 do
			local v27 = v23[v26].arguments[v24]
			if not v27 then
				table.remove(v23, v26)
			end
			if v27.kind == "literal" and (not v27.optional or v25 ~= nil) and v27.value ~= v25 then
				table.remove(v23, v26)
			end
		end
		if #v23 > 0 then
			v23 = table.clone(v23)
		end
	end
	if #v23 == 0 then
		error("no overload matches the given command")
	end
	return v23[1]
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_20

return function() -- name: create_signal
	local v_u_1 = {}
	return {
		["connect"] = function(_, p2) -- name: connect
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
			local v_u_3 = false
			local v_u_5 = {
				["callback"] = p2,
				["disconnect"] = function() -- name: disconnect
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_1
					if v_u_3 then
						return
					else
						v_u_3 = true
						v_u_5.disconnected = true
						local v4 = table.find(v_u_1, v_u_5)
						if v4 then
							table.remove(v_u_1, v4)
						end
					end
				end
			}
			local v6 = v_u_1
			table.insert(v6, v_u_5)
			return v_u_5
		end,
		["fire"] = function(_, ...) -- name: fire
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
			for _, v7 in v_u_1 do
				v7.callback(...)
			end
		end
	}
end

	["obtain_user_key"] = function(p6, p7) -- name: obtain_user_key
		if p6 then

			return ("server-%*"):format(p7)
		end
	end,
	["create_user"] = function(p8) -- name: create_user
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4
		local v9 = {
			["id"] = nil,

		local v11 = p8.name
		local v12
		if v10 then
			v12 = ("player-%*"):format(v10.UserId)

	end,

			p13.disconnected = true
			v_u_4.users[p13.id] = nil
		end
	end,
	["has_permissions"] = function(p14, ...) -- name: has_permissions
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4
		local v15 = { ... }
		for _, v16 in p14.roles do
			if v_u_2.ADMIN_ROLE == v16 then
				return true
			end
			if v_u_4.roles[v16] then
				for _, v17 in v_u_4.roles[v16] do
					local v18 = table.find(v15, v17)
					if v18 then
						table.remove(v15, v18)
						if #v15 == 0 then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end,
	["give_roles"] = function(p19, ...) -- name: give_roles
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_3
		if not p19.disconnected then
			local v20 = {}
			for v21 = 1, select("#", ...) do
				local v22 = select(v21, ...)
				if not table.find(v20, v22) then
					table.insert(v20, v22)
				end
			end
			for _, v23 in p19.roles do
				if not table.find(v20, v23) then
					table.insert(v20, v23)
				end
			end

				p19.dirty = true
				v_u_3.server.fire_update_user_roles(p19.player, {
					["id"] = p19.id,
					["roles"] = v20
				})
			end
		end
	end,
	["remove_roles"] = function(p24, ...) -- name: remove_roles
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3
		if not p24.disconnected then
			local v25 = table.clone(p24.roles)
			local v26 = { ... }

				end
			end

					["id"] = p24.id,
					["roles"] = v25
				})
			end
		end
	end
}
